d: We are seeking technically skilled and detail-oriented professionals to support civil engineering design, construction planning, infrastructure development, and project execution. The successful candidates will contribute to the planning, coordination, implementation, and evaluation of engineering and construction activities while ensuring technical accuracy, structural integrity, quality standards, and project efficiency.

Responsible for planning, designing, developing, and evaluating civil engineering projects, including buildings, roads, bridges, drainage systems, and other infrastructure. Duties include preparing engineering drawings, technical specifications, calculations, and design documentation; conducting site assessments and structural evaluations; coordinating with architects, contractors, consultants, and project teams; reviewing construction materials and methods; monitoring project progress; and ensuring compliance with engineering standards, building regulations, and safety requirements.

Responsible for coordinating and overseeing construction activities to ensure projects are delivered according to approved designs, specifications, schedules, and quality requirements. Duties include reviewing construction plans, coordinating contractors and subcontractors, monitoring site operations, managing construction resources and materials, evaluating project progress, identifying technical issues, and supporting effective problem-solving. The role also involves preparing progress reports, conducting site inspections, coordinating project documentation, and maintaining communication between engineering teams and relevant stakeholders.
Degree or relevant academic background in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related discipline.
Strong understanding of engineering principles, construction methods, structural systems, and technical documentation.
Ability to interpret engineering drawings, construction plans, specifications, and technical reports.
Familiarity with engineering design software, construction management tools, and project coordination systems.
Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to coordinate multiple project activities while maintaining accuracy, quality, and safety standards.
Professional attitude with a strong commitment to engineering excellence, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

etoro is the platform where you can trade, invest, save, and spend. Founded in 2007 with the vision of a world where everyone can trade and invest in a simple and transparent way, we've built a regulated, Nasdaq-listed platform used by millions of people in 75 countries.

We believe there is power in shared knowledge. By combining the collective intelligence of our community with AI-powered tools, we've created a collaborative investment community designed to help you grow your knowledge and wealth.

On etoro, you can hold a range of traditional and innovative assets and choose how you invest: trade directly, invest in a portfolio, copy other investors, or invest with an AI agent. Visit our Media Centre for the latest news.
You can find out more about eToro here.

eToro has created an intuitive Social Trading platform that gives traders and investors access to global stock markets, commodity trading, cryptocurrency trading, and more. We strive to make money management available and accessible to everyone (even to users with no prior experience or knowledge). We have over 33 million users worldwide, and our platform is available in over 75 countries around the world.
With over 1500 employees worldwide, we have locations in the US, Cyprus, UK, Australia, Germany, and Israel, and we are constantly growing and expanding into new markets.
We are constantly growing and are excited to share that we are looking for a Compliance Officer to join our team!

We're looking for a Compliance Officer to work with the Head of Compliance in the day-to-day operation of the local compliance framework. The role will be responsible for assigned compliance activities and may hold an FSRA Approved Person position, subject to the applicable FSRA approval requirements.

The Compliance Officer is responsible for assigned interactions and coordination with regulators, law enforcement and other competent bodies and authorities, and advises staff and senior management on relevant regulatory and internal compliance policy matters.
Are you the right fit for eToro?

Are you a customer and detailed oriented compliance, AML and/or financial crime professional? Are you agile and able to adapt quickly to changes? Do you have good communication skills? Are you keen to learn, can work independently and collaborate across different teams, functions and multiple jurisdictions? Are you a solution-oriented and driven individual? Do you have sound analytical skills? Then you may be the right fit for eToro.
q: At least 5 years of relevant compliance experience in financial services, including substantial experience with ADGM/FSRA-regulated firms or another UAE/local financial services regulator; experience in a deputy or second-in-command compliance role is preferred
Experience building and maintaining working relationships with regulators, with direct experience working with the FSRA and/or other ADGM or local UAE regulators required
Able to advise the Board, senior management and Group colleagues on complex regulatory issues
Experienced in successfully managing multiple projects and competing priorities at the same time
Able to work to short timelines in a fast-paced environment
Eligible to hold, or obtain approval for, an FSRA Approved Person / Authorized Individual function, where required for the position
Preference for virtual asset experience (at least 2 years)

At eToro, AI is transforming how we build, work, and decide, and our hiring now reflects this. We aim to be an AI-first organization, encouraging thoughtful AI use. Our recruitment uses AI tools, such as interview notetakers, to improve accuracy, consistency, and the candidate experience, supporting fair, consistent assessments grounded in human judgment, experience, and motivation. We want candidates who are comfortable with AI, who explore how they use AI tools, and who understand its opportunities and limitations. For us, being AI-first means augmenting human judgment, combining expertise and creativity with technology to do our best work and grow faster. Ultimately, we're hiring for human insight enhanced by AI.
At etoro, AI is changing how we build, work and make decisions, and our hiring approach reflects that. We are building an AI-first organisation where people are encouraged to use AI thoughtfully.

That starts with how we hire. Throughout our recruitment process, we may use AI-enabled tools, including interview notetakers and other technologies that help us capture information accurately, improve consistency and create a better experience for candidates and interviewers. These tools support our feedback and assessment outcomes. Hiring decisions remain grounded in running fair and consistent interview processes, human judgement, critical thinking, and thorough evaluation of experience, ability and motivation that are aligned to our business and role requirements.

We also want candidates to be comfortable working with AI. Depending on the role, we may explore how you use AI tools in your day-to-day work, how you think about their opportunities and limitations, and how you would contribute to etoro’s continued AI build-out.

For us, being AI-first is not about replacing human judgement. It is about combining human expertise, creativity and accountability with technology that helps us do our best work and accelerate our growth. In the end, that's what we're hiring for: human insight, supercharged by AI.
